files.README.md:
# session platform workspace

Two services take part in session lookups:

- edge-proxy terminates client traffic. Plain-text log in logs/edge-proxy.log; timestamps are UTC (trailing Z).
- session-store holds sessions in Redis. Plain-text log in logs/session-store.log; timestamps carry the APAC collector offset (+08:00).

Both services stamp the same request id (rq-...) on a call. See docs/paging-policy.md for the escalation matrix.
files.docs/paging-policy.md:
# Paging policy

- AUTH_FAIL on session-store is P1: sessions cannot be read, so sign-in fails for every region.
- SLOW_QUERY is P3: notify in #session-ops, no page unless it persists past 30 minutes.
- Postmortems record the incident onset instant and the originating fault code.

turns.prompt: An outage hit session lookups yesterday. For the incident report, give the instant the outage first showed a failure, expressed in Singapore time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
